note: Made by the steps in TV_PICTURES.md (trial stage, 2026-11-24): the chapter is split into sections that each carry one deep meaning, 10 picture ideas are written for each, and the top two for each picture are made as trials (candidates) to be chosen by eye. Wide pictures only (1920x1088). The important part of every picture sits in the upper 60% of the frame, clear of the word box. God is not pictured; Genesis 10 is a list of the peoples, so the pictures show what the list means (one family spreading into many nations, lands and languages) with the lands themselves, never Noah's sons beyond ordinary people of today. Nimrod is only an ordinary hunter seen from behind or in silhouette. No tower (Genesis 11) and no rainbow (Genesis 9).
method: Second method, asked for by Obay on 2026-11-21: (1) split the chapter into sections that each carry one deep meaning, written as one plain sentence; (2) write 10 different picture ideas for each section; (3) judge them: which shows the deep meaning most truly, then which a watcher understands at once while hearing the words, then which is most engaging; (4) make the top two for each picture slot as real pictures ("candidates") and choose by eye.

sections.meaning: After the flood the whole human family begins again from Noah's three sons: one family, three branches.
ideas: One old tree whose trunk divides into three great boughs under a clear morning sky
Three brothers seen from behind walking side by side on a wet road across a fresh green plain
Three young saplings growing from one rain-soaked field
A family tree growing out of one root, three thick limbs
Three rivers leaving one lake
A tray of three seed packets spilled on a table
Three paths leaving one doorstep into green country
A father's hand on three sons' shoulders
Three candles lit from one flame
One loaf broken in three pieces

sections.meaning: Japheth's sons spread out to the coastlands, and the coastland nations separated, each in its own land, with its own language and family.

A ferry crossing between two islands
A ship's wake across a calm sea at dawn
A fisherman's net drying on a quay
A chain of green islands in mist
Three boats leaving one bay in three directions

sections.meaning: Nimrod was the first mighty man on earth, a mighty hunter before Yahweh, and his kingdom began with cities in Shinar and he built a great city.

sections.meaning: From Egypt and Canaan came many peoples and families, who were scattered over the land within a border that ran from Sidon to Gaza and to Sodom.

A seaside bazaar with groups in different dress talking with their hands
A crossroads of four roads with travelers
A busy quay with sailors from many ships

A beach of coastal dunes stretching toward a distant city
Seeds blown from a farmer's open hand across a field

sections.meaning: Shem, the older brother of Japheth, became the father of all the sons of Eber, and his family grew branch by branch.

A family tree pinned on a wall of photographs
A row of boots from big to small at a door

A grandfather teaching a grandchild to plant a tree
Hands of many ages around one bowl

sections.meaning: In Peleg's days the earth was divided; Joktan's many sons settled from Mesha to Sephar, in the hill country of the east.

sections.meaning: From these three families the nations spread over the earth after the flood.

candidates.principle: And these are the generations of the sons of Noah: Shem, Ham, and Japheth. And sons were born to them after the flood.
candidates.shows: One huge old tree in a green field washed clean by rain, its trunk dividing into three great boughs that spread wide into the morning sky.
candidates.prompt: At dawn, one huge old oak tree stands alone in a green field freshly washed by rain, mist lying low on the grass; its trunk divides low down into three great boughs that spread wide apart into the clear morning sky, so the three limbs are plain to see. The tree and sky are in the upper part of the frame.  The important part is in the upper half of the picture; the lower part is plain foreground.
